label: Dead area of a pair
subgoals: Compute the bounding rectangle of the two entries
Subtract both entries' areas from its area
Interpret a large value as a poor pairing

label: Picking seeds
subgoals: Score every pair of entries by dead area
Choose the pair with the largest dead area as seeds
Assign the remaining entries by least enlargement

label: Overlap and margin in the R*-tree
section: Overlap and margin in the R*-tree
subgoals: Form the two group bounding rectangles of a candidate split
Sum their perimeters to get the margin
Compute the overlap area of the two groups
